name: CENTRO DE COMANDOS IA OFFLINE
safetyGateLimit: The gate is preventive and rule-based. It is not a local AI model, does not claim total moderation coverage, and does not replace the external AI safety system.
taskExecutionLimit: The application does not generate work tasks, does not execute harmful instructions, and does not ask an external AI to perform a crime or produce unsafe content. It only creates professional activation commands that require the external AI to activate a mode, confirm it, and wait for the user's later task.
externalAISafetyLayerObserved: External AI systems tested by the user rejected unsafe downstream tasks even when a mode command had already been activated. This is recorded as observed behavior, not as a universal guarantee.
testedExternalAIInterpretationNote: Observed during external development testing; not a reproducible property of this package and not a universal guarantee.
windowsE2EUserTestScope: real-use walkthrough reported by the user on Windows: 100-percent zoom, guided creation, area switching, selection, generation, copy, activation and mode replacement across external conversational AI chats
releasePurpose: Distribución estable del Centro de Comandos IA Offline con raíz de usuario limpia, arquitectura explorable y batería de regresión incorporada.
changeSummary: Batería reproducible de regresión Node.js para catálogo, compilador, compatibilidad, seguridad, persistencia y artefactos offline.
Content Security Policy local sin conexiones de red para la interfaz.
Eliminación de ExecutionPolicy Bypass de los iniciadores Windows.
Alineación del manifiesto con el esquema de almacenamiento real (versión 12), manteniendo favoritos como único dato persistente.
Documentación y manifiesto alineados exclusivamente con esta distribución.
Reorganización de distribución: único punto de entrada visible en la raíz, documentación de uso visible y archivos técnicos agrupados en SISTEMA_INTERNO sin ocultamiento de sistema.
Eliminación de CREAR_ACCESO_DIRECTO.bat por redundancia con las funciones nativas de Windows.

regressionSuite.runtimeDependency: Node.js solo para validación; no es dependencia de la aplicación.

contentSecurityPolicy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; connect-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
modeCatalogBoundary: Modes are not generated from arbitrary requests and users cannot create new capability cards. The application only selects, filters, orders, and combines pre-existing official capabilities from the built-in catalog; up to 5 existing capabilities can be combined per mode. No unlawful mode card exists in the official catalog.
ethicalBoundary: Outside the law: nothing. Within the law: everything compatible with the official capability catalog, applicable policies, and professional safeguards.
preventiveSafetyGatePurpose: Ethical preventive layer for explicit unsafe mode requests; it is intentionally lightweight because the application is offline and does not contain a local AI moderation model. It is not the primary safety boundary.
externalAISafetyLayerRole: Primary downstream safety enforcement remains with the external AI provider when the generated activation command is later used; observed tests showed unsafe downstream requests were rejected after mode activation.
schemaVersionDecision: 12; the release changes application hardening and packaging but does not introduce a storage-schema migration requiring a new schema number.
legacyFavoritesMigrationNote: Legacy favorites are migrated into the current favorites store; transient draft/context data is not migrated. Legacy keys may remain physically present unless explicitly cleared by the host environment.
helpInterface: The application includes a Help button in the upper-right area that opens the 'Cómo utilizar el sistema' guide.
favoritesBoundary: Favorites are references to built-in official capabilities only. Users may mark or unmark existing capabilities as favorites; they cannot create new favorite commands or new capability definitions.
externalValidationStatus: The package has been exercised by the user in real conversational AI workflows, including mode activation, persistent mode signature, task-after-activation behavior, and mode replacement within a conversation. This is operational evidence for the mode-command concept, not a universal guarantee across all AI providers.
